description: ∉ removes a membership, and a key can gain and lose a class again. ko'a ends with no class, and classify gives ∅ for it (engine §2, §10).
grammar:
%classifier lex  "ko'a" ∈ KOhA  "ko'a" ∉ KOhA  "ko'a" ∈ KOhA  "ko'a" ∉ KOhA  "ko'e" ∈ KOhA





%rule text [{word}]
%rule word $w:W :: (Tag-w ∪ $w.value.classify(lex)) %emits $
